notes.title: Alpha 0.21
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 0.21 is out now![/b]
You can try it in the demo version!

[h3][NEW][/h3]
[b]Building system[/b] - (build what you want, where you want...)

[h3][Changelog][/h3]
 - Farming with the free building system will be available much sooner, and ingredients have been added to the trader.
 - Replaced and added new sounds
 - Underwater sounds have been added.
 - Improved merchant (interface, product names) and more...
 - Price balance
 - The radius of the area available at the beginning of the game has been doubled
Bug fixes:
 - Fixed a bug where loot fell underground
 - Spear collider fixed

In general, there are quite a few small and unimportant changes...

notes.title: Alpha 0.20 is available for everyone as a demo version
notes.content:
Hello!
[h2]Alpha 0.20 on 07/14/24 is now available as a demo![/h2]

I'm currently working on Alpha 0.21, a short list of plans for the next version

[b](Important)[/b]
Among the big innovations we plan to introduce a free building system (so that the player can take a building recipe and place the building on the island by himself)

Also:
 - Adding more sounds (player, environment, etc.)
 - Fixing existing bugs
 - Improving the visuals of selling trade items
 - Farming will be available much earlier
 - Changing the prices of several items
 - A few more small changes

I will be very happy for your feedback
 - What do you want to see in the game
 - What you don't understand about the game
 - Bugs...
 - and more...
